newsitem.title: UNITED NATIONS: Developed states responsible for pollution - Iran.
newsitem.headline: Developed states responsible for pollution - Iran.

text.p: Iran said on Wednesday developed countries must bear more responsibility for safeguarding the environment because of their record of pollution and their access to technology and finance.

"While we have a collective responsibility for preservation of the environment, the nature and scope of this responsibility for various members of the international community are not identical," Iranian Foreign Minister Ali Akbar Velayati said.
He told an Earth Summit reviewing progress since a 1992 U.N. environment conference in Rio de Janeiro:

"Given their role in environmental degradation in the past two centuries and their current access to environmentally-sound technologies and financial resources, developed countries particularly bear a special legal and moral responsibility."
Instead of "imposing new constraints and commitments on the developing countries," they should start living up to their own undertakings, Velayati said.

"It is totally unjustifiable that the developing world is asked to pay the price of environmental degradation historically perpetrated by the industrialised nations, who continue to date to have the largest share in polluting our environment, notwithstanding their propaganda on environmental preservation," he said.
